GUIDE_MODE_BASIC: Basic · Short tips as new things open
GUIDE_OVERVIEW_DETAIL: Drag the joystick to walk. Stand still near an enemy to attack. Tap dropped loot to pick it up.
GUIDE_COLLECT_WAIT_DETAIL: Your first weapon or outfit drops within a few defeats.
GUIDE_MERGE_WAIT_DETAIL: A matching copy drops within a few more defeats.
GUIDE_TIP_EQUIP: New gear: tap it, then Equip
GUIDE_TIP_EQUIP_DETAIL: Equipped gear gives full stats. Stored gear still adds a share.
GUIDE_TIP_MERGE: Two of the same: open it, then Merge
GUIDE_TIP_MERGE_DETAIL: Merging a spare copy makes the item permanently stronger.
GUIDE_MISSIONS_DETAIL: Objectives and daily missions pay coins and gems.
GUIDE_MISSIONS_CLAIM_DETAIL: Finished objectives wait here until you claim their reward.
GUIDE_MISSIONS_WAIT_DETAIL: The Missions button shows ! when a reward is ready.
GUIDE_SLOTS_DETAIL: Player Upgrades last for this run; Gem upgrades are kept forever.
GUIDE_SLOTS_TAB_DETAIL: More equipment slots let you keep more kinds of gear.
GUIDE_SLOTS_BUY_DETAIL: Each kind of item needs its own slot; copies stack.
GUIDE_SLOTS_POTION_DETAIL: Tap a potion in your supplies to heal during a fight.
GUIDE_SLOTS_EARN: Earn coins for a Health Potion
GUIDE_SLOTS_EARN_DETAIL: %s more coins needed. Every defeated enemy drops coins.
GUIDE_SNOWMAN_DETAIL: It unlocks Winter II and Prestige. Merge gear, level up and bring potions first.
GUIDE_PRESTIGE_FOLLOW_DETAIL: Its next step shows on the map. When one is Ready, Prestige restarts the world and you keep the card.
GUIDE_PRESTIGE_INFO_DETAIL: New opportunities appear as you play. When one is Ready, Prestige restarts the world and you keep the card.
GUIDE_FEATURE_MISSIONS_DETAIL: Objectives and daily missions pay coins and gems. Claim them in Missions.
GUIDE_FEATURE_ENEMY_DETAIL: Tap Upgrades above the map (or an enemy) to raise its loot, coins and XP.
GUIDE_FEATURE_WORLD_DETAIL: The minimap and World show where you have been. Unlock camps to respawn and rest there.
GUIDE_FEATURE_UPGRADES_DETAIL: Buy equipment slots, supplies and permanent Gem upgrades in Upgrades.
GUIDE_FEATURE_OBJECTIVE_DETAIL: It unlocks Winter II and Prestige. Merge gear, level up and bring potions first.
GUIDE_FEATURE_PRESTIGE_DETAIL: Complete an opportunity, then Prestige to restart with a permanent card.
MAIN_4: Defeat the Snowman · unlocks Winter II and Prestige
SHOW_ALL_MENUS_CONFIRM: Show every menu now? New menus normally appear as you learn the game. Prestige still needs the Snowman's defeat.
MASTERY_INTRO: Optional goals for 100% completion. Progress is permanent and kept by Prestige.
MASTERY_EXPLORE_RULE: Explore the whole map and unlock every camp.
MASTERY_HUNT_RULE: Defeat %s of each enemy type and %s of each boss.
MASTERY_RESEARCH_RULE: Reveal Stats and Drops for every enemy here.
MASTERY_COLLECT_RULE: Obtain every weapon, outfit and skill dropped here.
MASTERY_FORGE_RULE: Outfits from here to ^%s (boss outfits ^%s) and one weapon from here evolved.
MILESTONE_PRESTIGE_UNLOCKED_NONE: Complete an opportunity, then Prestige for a permanent card
AUDIO_HINT: Gameplay sounds: taps, purchases, merges and combat. Special sounds: notifications (a mission or objective ready to claim, Prestige news, a new menu, Map Mastery progress) and milestones (a new map, a Prestige). The sound-effect volume sets both.
